finding: TPEx public pages and format documentation verify a free daily security-level corporate-bond fair-value/reference lane, while full historical after-market bulk files are a separate data-product route. A 2022-12-30 official fair-value report exposes bond code, short name, maturity, coupon, reference curve, fair value and yield for many corporate bonds. This is sufficient to refine the source architecture but not to claim multi-date transaction replay.

sourceRoute.semantics: Trade, quote, reference and fair-value observations remain distinct provenance classes.

freeFairValueLane.methodology: TPEx fair value uses bond information reported on MOPS and TPEx corporate-bond reference yield curves; eligible bonds are constrained by currency/rate/maturity/option/rating rules.

historicalBulkLane.note: Historical bulk access is not treated as already acquired.

blockers: Free fair-value/reference observations are model/reference evidence and must never be labeled actual trades.
A cross-issuer multi-date issuer-security replay is not yet materialized from the public daily-report route.
Actual transaction/quote history remains unavailable in the current research packet.
No-trade/stale observations cannot be forward-filled as market yields.
Duration/currency/optionality mismatch blocks clean issuer-spread construction.

decision.reason: The source blocker is narrowed, not removed. A security-level fair-value lane is verified, but L3 still requires reproducible multi-date issuer-security replay with provenance and benchmark matching; actual-trade claims require transaction data.

next: Materialize at least multiple official daily fair-value reports on independent dates and issuers through a reproducible public transport path.
Keep the fair-value lane separate from actual-trade/quote lanes in all schemas.
Match reference/yield observations to currency-, maturity- and option-consistent benchmarks before computing any spread.
Promote only the specific replayable provenance lane that passes; never generalize fair-value feasibility into transaction feasibility.
